Description
Ultra-luxury wellness resort on a 26 ha estate in the UNESCO-listed Douro Valley — 71 keys plus up to 50 private villas across two phases. Opening Nov 2029. Structure: 50% JV (share purchase), BOA Hotels Advisory has committed the matching 50% alongside investors. Hold 7 years (exit Dec 2033). Non-dilutive EU PT2030 grants of €10.4M. Hurdle 8% compound preferred return; waterfall 80% investors / 20% GP above hurdle. Exit at 8% cap rate on 2032 NOI → €65.9M hotel-only gross. 2h from Porto.
History
Investor teaser (March 2026 vintage) circulated to: Realaize, Azora, BWH / WorldHotels, Sempre, BlueCrow, Bairro Lab, Gremio, Nobu, Joana da Matlaw (GRI Madrid), Pedro Rizo (Nhood). Three return scenarios on identical €9M (50%) equity / waterfall: Base Hotel-Only 23.7% IRR · 3.59× MOIC · €32.9M return; Hotel + 20 Villas Phase 1 27.3% IRR · 4.00× MOIC · €36.7M return; Full Hotel + 50-Villa Estate 30.5% IRR · 4.71× MOIC · €43.2M return. Public site: kurabyboa.com.
